note: All documents are fictional synthetic references for the Flying_Florina demo.

documents.title: Fleet Health Monitoring Overview (fictional)
documents.body: Describes how the demo fleet health index is computed from synthetic telemetry: vibration index, EGT delta and oil pressure index. Health scores are demo heuristics, not airworthiness determinations. FICTIONAL DEMO CONTENT - synthetic reference, not an official manual and not for operational use.

documents.title: Vibration Trend Review Procedure (fictional)
documents.body: When the vibration index trend for an engine position rises for more than five consecutive days, a reliability engineer reviews the trend, checks sensor data quality, compares with fleet peers and requests an inspection task. The fictional demo threshold for the index is 1.0. Exceedance triggers review, not a flight decision. FICTIONAL DEMO CONTENT - synthetic reference, not an official manual and not for operational use.

documents.title: Engine Mount Isolator Inspection Task Card (fictional)
documents.body: Inspect engine mount isolators for cracking, delamination and fluid contamination. Record findings with photos in the work order. If degradation is found, raise a replacement work order for part P-7731 and obtain planner approval. Estimated labor: 3.0 hours, one technician qualified for engine mount replacement (demo). FICTIONAL DEMO CONTENT - synthetic reference, not an official manual and not for operational use.

documents.title: Engine Mount Isolator Replacement Procedure (fictional)
documents.body: Replacement of isolator kit P-7731 requires two technicians, one holding Engine mount replacement (demo) and one holding Kestrel engine run-up (demo). Estimated labor 7.5 hours plus 1.5 hours ground run. Return to service is a human authorization step under DOC-014 and is never performed by software. FICTIONAL DEMO CONTENT - synthetic reference, not an official manual and not for operational use.

documents.title: Borescope Inspection Guidance (fictional)
documents.body: Borescope inspection is used to look for internal damage when vibration and EGT trends move together. Requires Borescope inspection (demo) qualification. Typical duration 2-4 hours. FICTIONAL DEMO CONTENT - synthetic reference, not an official manual and not for operational use.

documents.title: Sensor Data Quality Handling (fictional)
documents.body: Missing readings, flat-lined signals and single-day spikes are treated as data-quality issues before they are treated as component findings. A single isolated spike that does not persist is usually a sensor glitch and should be confirmed by a second reading. FICTIONAL DEMO CONTENT - synthetic reference, not an official manual and not for operational use.
